nodes.label: Sidebar Configuration UI (v7)
nodes.rationale: Version 7 sidebar navigation with real-time setting search, preset manager, profile export/import, and toast notifications

nodes.label: Live Combat Statistics
nodes.rationale: Real-time DPS over a 15s rolling window, kills per minute (KPM), and total combat duration

nodes.label: Auto-Eat Sustenance Module
nodes.rationale: Automatically consumes food from hotbar or inventory when hunger or health drops

nodes.label: Auto-Totem Offhand Replenisher
nodes.rationale: Instantly slots a Totem of Undying from inventory into offhand when player health is critically low

nodes.label: Smart Offhand Situational Swapper
nodes.rationale: Intelligently swaps shields, golden apples, totems, and fireworks based on immediate combat situation

nodes.label: In-Game HUD Overlay
nodes.rationale: Multi-corner display (Top-Left, Top-Right, Bottom-Left, Bottom-Right) showing active state, CPS, DPS, KPM, Ping, TPS, and active modules

nodes.label: Native Vertex-Buffer Render Upgrade
nodes.rationale: Upgraded 3D ESP rendering pipeline to native RenderType.lines() and RenderType.debugQuads() compatible with modern Minecraft 1.21.8+ graphics pipelines

nodes.label: 3D ESP Target Highlighter
nodes.rationale: Native vertex-buffer rendering with 8 modes (Box, Filled, Circle, Arrow, Beacon, Glow, Cylinder, Cone) and 10 palette colors compatible with modern Minecraft graphics pipelines

nodes.label: Auto-Fish Autonomous Fishing
nodes.rationale: Autonomous fishing with splash-particle and bobber movement detection

nodes.label: Auto-Walk Obstacle Navigation
nodes.rationale: Continuous hands-free walking with obstacle jump assist

nodes.label: Target Entity Filters
nodes.rationale: Fine-grained target filtering for players, hostile mobs, neutral/passive animals, teammates, and invisible entities

nodes.label: Centralized Profile Storage & Logging
nodes.rationale: Migrated profile configs to standard config/multiclicker-profiles/ with centralized SLF4J/Log4j2 logging for consistency and clean configuration management

nodes.label: Click and Hold Channels
nodes.rationale: Dual operating modes offering high-frequency clicking up to 20 CPS and continuous button holding for N ticks

nodes.label: Auto Clicker Engine (CombatClickerModule)
nodes.rationale: Independent LMB, RMB, and Jump channels with separate Click/Hold modes, speeds, and randomization ranges

nodes.label: MultiClicker Mod
nodes.rationale: A modern, modular automation and auto-clicker mod for Minecraft 1.21.8 designed with component-based architecture, humanization algorithms to bypass anti-cheat heuristics, and survival fail-safes

nodes.label: Melee Weapon Check
nodes.rationale: Restricts auto-clicker activation to melee weapons like swords, axes, maces, and tridents

nodes.label: Architectury Loom Modernization
nodes.rationale: Modernized modular architecture targeting Fabric and NeoForge using Architectury Loom to support unified multi-loader builds while removing legacy artifacts

nodes.label: Adaptive Mining System
nodes.rationale: Automatically distinguishes between attacking entities and breaking blocks, switching to continuous break logic

nodes.label: Armor Stand Protection
nodes.rationale: Prevents accidental destruction of armor stands, item frames, and decorative entities during latency spikes or spam-clicking

nodes.label: Auto Criticals Fall Phase Timing
nodes.rationale: Optimizes attack timing during the players downward fall phase for 100% critical hit rate

nodes.label: 1.9+ Attack Cooldown Synchronization
nodes.rationale: Automatically synchronizes strikes with attack charge meter to maximize DPS and avoid wasted weak swings

nodes.label: Gaussian Click Distribution
nodes.rationale: Simulates human click timings using normal distribution rather than predictable linear randomization to bypass anti-cheat statistical heuristics

nodes.label: Human Jitter & Miss Penalties
nodes.rationale: Dynamically reduces CPS when looking away from targets and emulates hand micro-movements to mimic realistic human aim imperfections

nodes.label: Network Lag Compensation & Safe Disconnect
nodes.rationale: Tracks real-time ping and server TPS, pausing clicks during network freezes and safely disconnecting without stuck keys

nodes.label: Panic Mode Emergency Trigger
nodes.rationale: Emergency triggers when health drops below critical threshold to auto-disconnect or retreat safely

nodes.label: Auto-Tool Hotbar Swapper
nodes.rationale: Instantly switches to the fastest hotbar tool for the target block being mined

nodes.label: Anti-AFK Kick Evasion
nodes.rationale: Evades server AFK kicks using pseudo-random micro-movements, pitch/yaw rotation, and jumps

nodes.label: Trash Drop Discarder
nodes.rationale: Configurable list of unwanted items to automatically discard from inventory
